title: 第七百九十七章 消失的实力第七百九十六章 交朋结友
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 第七百九十七章消失的实力
冯斗原本以为自己的修为达到了圣神境一段，无论怎么样都能够一搏的，可是当他真正地与对方一搏时，他却是彻底地蒙圈了，根本就不是那么一回事啦！
他居然感受到不到他体内有任何的一丝丝灵气，他瞬间蒙圈了，到底是什么回事呢？
这样一来不由得让冯斗彻底地不知道为何了，他尝试沟通自己的灵气海，他却惊讶地发现了一件事，那就是他不单单是没有灵气的，就连他体内的灵气海都已经完全地消失，到底是什么情况呢？
就连此时的冯斗都已经开始怀疑一点，他到底是什么情况呢？？莫非这一切都是一场梦，他根本就从来没有过灵气这个东西吗？
可是眼前这一切却这样真实，根本就不像是梦，那么到底什么才是梦，什么才是真呢？
这样一来不由得让冯斗彻底地迷惑自己现在的修为到底是什么情况呢？
这个时候，就连冯斗都没有办法分得清楚到底什么是真，什么是假啦！
可是时间不等他了，他的那一拳已经到位，不得不迎接了，就在此时，对方也是实实地接了冯斗的这一拳，结果却硬硬地接了这一拳，两人同时弹开，可是此时的冯斗却没有感受到疼痛，反而是让他觉得相当吃惊的东西发生了，那就是他的肉身力量居然还是存在的，然而对方也是没有任何的灵气，这样一来他反而有点不惧了。
毕竟肉体上他还是占有一定的优势，他可是肉体成圣的状态，以同阶的人相比来说，绝对是占有很大的优势的，他现在也并没有搞清楚到底是什么样的情况，但是他选择先以肉体来试试，到底是什么样的情况啦！
冯斗当然也不会就这样放弃了，他说：“你到底是何人呢？为何会出现这里？”
然而对方此时是蒙住脸的，这时的冯斗根本就没有办法看得清楚对方的脸部，到底是什么情况呢？
对方显然没有打算就这样放过冯斗的意思，他说：“那就是要拿你小命的人，拿命来！”
不知道何时对方的手中突然之间多出一把匕首，那把匕首直接刺向了冯斗，冯斗也不是吃素的，他瞬间就已经来到了冯斗的眼前，他直接一刀刺向冯斗的胸口处，可是冯斗绝对不是那种任由他拿扭的人。
他利用脚步优势后撤一大步，一拳打向那个人的脸颊，这样一来就已经逼着那个人不得不抽身离开，对方一抽身就已经让冯斗的这一拳完全地落空了，他的脚尖单指地上，马上腾空而起，直接追上了对方后撤。
然而对方也不是什么善茬，就当冯斗追上他的步伐时，他回手一刀直接刺向冯斗，这样一来就不由得让冯斗来个鲤鱼打挺后空翻，结果他的那把匕首直接划向冯斗的脸颊之处。
好在冯斗躲避过那把匕首，差点就已经让对方直接开了个口，不由得让冯斗都觉得心里有那么一丝丝唏嘘的，毕竟这样的情况，他还是太久没有遇见到的，毕竟这时冯斗等同于一个废人一样的。
这一点是他需要真正地了解清楚，不然他真的不甘心。
第七百九十七章消失的实力
此时就已经是短暂两次交手，双方都是没有占到任何便宜，也算得上互送几招，冯斗却在对方的身上感受到一股熟悉的感觉，到底是什么情况呢？可是冯斗却相当清楚自己根本就不认识这个人，但是对方又是何人呢？
真的算得上百思不得其解了，可是冯斗又不愿意就这样放弃了，毕竟这里实在有太多未知的东西。
就这样冯斗与对方大大小小战了不止百招了，他们身上都已经是出现大大小小不少的伤口，他们两个人都已经气喘吁吁的，随着越来越多对战时，就已经让冯斗渐渐地发觉眼前这个人仿佛对于自己的招算得上熟悉不已，他感觉这个人的身上有自己的气息，他就有点想不过来的，到底为何呢？
这里到底是怎么回事，这个人为何能够猜得出自己将要出什么招式的呢？
莫非他是自己心里的蛔虫吗？
不然他怎么样可能猜得出自己的一举一动呢？
冯斗再次不死心道：“你到底是何人呢？为何你能够猜得出我的招式呢？”
对方却笑道：“就你这些三脚猫功夫，想要知道又有何难呢？不服再战！”
就在此时，冯斗也是有点百思不得其解的，听到了对方的话之后，他就更加觉得这当中绝对不会那么简单的，甚至来说，他觉得有点不得不重新审视一点，那就是为何这一关被称为心关，不应该是直视自己的内心吗？
能够回到族地这一点，他能够了解这一点，但是现在出现眼前这个人，却他不得不重新审视这一切，毕竟现在他也没有绝对的把握能够胜得了对方，甚至来说，隐隐之中对方有点压制自己的意思啦！
正是如此，冯斗也不得不另辟蹊径找到全新的办法来对付他，不然真的可能会被对方彻底地耗死的，这一点也是冯斗最不愿意接受的，毕竟现在的冯斗算得上受到各个方面的压制，让他根本就反应不过来的。
转眼之间，他们两个人又大战了几百个回合，他们都已经彻底地累倒了，冯斗也是第一次遇到这样的情况，他一直都感觉到自己是在与自己的对打，究竟是什么情况呢？
就在此时冯斗突然之间觉得眼前的这个人越来越清晰的，只不过是他一直都不愿意接受这样的结果而已！
其实也是因为那句话，心关最重要的事情就是自己的内心啦！
冯斗心里想：心关无非就是自己的内心最恐惧的东西，然而族地属于我内心的那块地方，自然有这个属于正常的，但是到底是什么情况导致出现这个人呢？莫非这个人不是其他人只是我内心的恐惧啦！如果是这样的，那就代表着一件事，那就是这一切并没有表面上的那么简单啦！至于我消失的实力到底去了哪里呢？
其实这一个就是冯斗一直都在怀疑的，毕竟现在的冯斗完全地丧失了灵气，根本就没有办法发挥出自己真实的实力，那就不是那么简单了，甚至来说，可能会让他都觉得相当无语的存在。
到底是发生了什么情况呢？他自己都不知道应该问何人啦！

Chapter 797 The disappearing strength
Feng Dou originally thought that his cultivation had reached the level of the Holy God and that he could fight no matter what. However, when he actually fought with the opponent, he was completely fooled. That was not the case at all!
He actually couldn't feel any spiritual energy in his body. He was instantly confused. What was going on?
This made Feng Dou completely confused. He tried to communicate with his sea of ​​spiritual energy, but he was surprised to find one thing. Not only did he have no spiritual energy, but the sea of ​​spiritual energy in his body had completely disappeared. What was going on?
Even Feng Dou at this time had begun to doubt a little, what was going on with him? ? Could it be that this was all a dream and that he never had such a thing as spiritual energy?
But everything in front of me is so real, it doesn't look like a dream at all. So what is a dream and what is reality?
This made Feng Dou completely confused as to what his current cultivation level was.
At this time, even Feng Dou couldn't tell clearly what was true and what was false!
But time did not wait for him. His punch was already in place and he had to welcome it. At this moment, the opponent actually received Feng Dou's punch, but he received the punch hard. The two of them bounced away at the same time, but Feng Dou did not feel the pain at this time. Instead, something quite surprising happened to him, that is, his physical strength still existed, but the opponent did not have any spiritual energy, so he was not afraid anymore.
After all, he still has a certain advantage physically. He is in a state of physical sanctification. Compared with people of the same level, he definitely has a great advantage. He doesn't know what the situation is yet, but he chooses to try it with his body first to see what the situation is like!
Of course Feng Dou would not give up just like that. He said, "Who are you? Why are you here?"
However, the other party's face was covered at this time. At this time, Feng Dou had no way to see the other party's face clearly. What was going on?
The other party obviously had no intention of letting Feng Dou go just like this. He said, "That's the person who wants to take your life. Take his life!"
I don't know when a dagger suddenly appeared in the opponent's hand, and the dagger stabbed Feng Dou directly. Feng Dou was not a vegetarian. He was in front of Feng Dou in an instant. He stabbed Feng Dou directly in the chest, but Feng Dou was definitely not the kind of person to let him twist.
He took advantage of his footsteps to take a big step back and punched the person in the cheek. This forced the person to pull away. As soon as the other person pulled away, Feng Dou's punch was completely missed. With one toe pointing to the ground, he immediately jumped into the air and directly caught up with the opponent and retreated.
However, the opponent was not a good person. When Feng Dou caught up with him, he returned his hand and stabbed Feng Dou directly. This made Feng Dou do a carp back flip, and as a result, his dagger directly struck Feng Dou's cheek.
Fortunately, Feng Dou dodged the dagger and almost made the other party open his mouth. Feng Dou couldn't help but feel a little bit sad in his heart. After all, he hadn't seen such a situation for a long time. After all, Feng Dou was like a useless person at this time.
This is something he needs to truly understand, otherwise he will really not be willing to accept it.
Chapter 797 The disappearing strength
At this time, there had been two brief battles. Neither side took any advantage, and they could only exchange a few moves. However, Feng Dou felt a familiar feeling on the other side. What was going on? But Feng Dou knew very well that he didn't know this person at all, but who was he?
It was really puzzling, but Feng Dou was unwilling to give up just like that. After all, there were too many unknown things here.
In this way, Feng Dou fought with the opponent for more than a hundred moves. There were already many wounds on their bodies, and they were both out of breath. As they fought more and more, Feng Dou gradually realized that the person in front of him seemed to be familiar with his moves. He felt that this person had his own aura, and he couldn't figure it out. Why?
What is going on here, and how can this person guess what moves he is going to make?
Could it be that he is the tapeworm in his heart?
Otherwise, how could he possibly guess his every move?
Feng Dou said again without giving up: "Who are you? Why can you guess my moves?"
But the other party smiled and said: "With your three-legged cat skills, what's the problem if you want to know? If you don't accept it, keep fighting!"
At this moment, Feng Dou was also a little puzzled. After hearing what the other party said, he felt that it was definitely not that simple. In fact, he felt that he had to re-examine something. That is why this level is called the heart level. Shouldn't it mean looking directly into his own heart?
He can understand the fact that he can return to his clan, but now that this person appears in front of him, he has to re-examine everything. After all, he is not absolutely sure that he can defeat the other party. In fact, the other party is vaguely trying to suppress him!
Just like this, Feng Dou had to find a new way to deal with him, otherwise he might be completely consumed by the opponent. This is what Feng Dou is least willing to accept. After all, Feng Dou is now suppressed from all aspects, and he cannot react at all.
In the blink of an eye, the two of them fought for hundreds of rounds, and they were both completely exhausted. This was the first time Feng Dou encountered such a situation. He always felt that he was fighting against himself. What exactly was going on?
At this moment, Feng Dou suddenly felt that it was becoming clearer and clearer to the person in front of him. It was just that he had never been willing to accept such a result!
In fact, it is also because of that sentence, the most important thing about your heart is your own heart!
Feng Dou thought to himself: The heart connection is nothing more than the thing that scares me the most. However, the clan land belongs to the place in my heart. Naturally, it is normal to have this. But what is the situation that caused this person to appear? Could it be that this person is not someone else but my inner fear? If this is the case, it means one thing, that is, everything is not as simple as it seems! As for where did my disappeared strength go?
In fact, this is what Feng Dou has always suspected. After all, Feng Dou has completely lost his spiritual energy and has no way to show his true strength. It is not that simple. In fact, it may even make him feel quite speechless.
What happened? He didn’t even know who to ask!
